User.doc: App operator, never automatically a signer. Bootstrap via local CLI, no public user creation API.

AuthSession.doc: Store only hashes, never raw browser tokens.

Agency.doc: Directory/configuration state is not legal authority. fieldAttributions has schema and source checks in service.

fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

Owner.doc: Client namespace, not proof of work ownership.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

LegalSubject.doc: Exact person or legal entity. Names/registration are matching hints, not automatic global deduplication.

fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

Signer.doc: Person in an agency capacity. No signature blob, adoption, or send endpoint.

MandateVersion.doc: Freeze parent plus all coverage/signer children atomically before selection; successors do not automatically legally supersede predecessors.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

MandateCoverage.doc: Draft-editable only while parent version DRAFT. Source-backed legal changes are append-only AuthorityEvents.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

CoverageSigner.doc: Never confers rights merely from insertion; parent version must be draft to alter this row.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

AuthorityEvent.doc: Records observed currentness/revocation etc. Nullable coverage means whole mandate only if source supports it. No legal action is executed.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

CaseRecord.doc: Business case, not an automated legal verdict. Canonical code only binds to an actual sourced existing/registered code.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

CaseAuthoritySelection.doc: Immutable explicit selection; a new default signer does not rewrite this selection. Server checks case route equals selected route.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

CaseAuthorityCoverage.doc: One or more precisely scoped coverages. Do not union grants into unsupported authority.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

ReportedItem.doc: Only YouTube video formats in V1. Identifier remains case-sensitive. No global uniqueness across cases.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

UseMapping.doc: Integer milliseconds exposed as decimal strings. Duration equality is never AV verification.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

SourceReference.doc: Immutable capture metadata, not a guarantee of truth. A URL hash is not a content hash. Null agency only for public/shared-scoped sources, not permission to cross agencies.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

CaseFact.doc: Append-only revisions. The value schema is selected by FactType. Latest successor is current; WITHDRAWN is a retraction, not deletion.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

FactSource.doc: Server must check CaseFact.caseId = CaseSource.caseId. Named supporting assertion is not authentication.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

Correspondence.doc: Preserve actual observations; not a send API. Source identity hash derived from a trustworthy provider/capture identity, never subject or Message-ID alone.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

CorrespondenceBinding.doc: Append-only semantic binding. Corrections create successors; one transmission may bind to multiple URLs. Outcome requires a specific item in V1.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

PromptSnapshot.doc: Exact immutable prompt/context. SHA-256 of exact stored UTF-8 text, not a legal attestation.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

NoticeCandidate.doc: Content immutable at insert. PATCH body is forbidden. Only supersededAt/reason may be set by dedicated command. Artifact hash binds body, subject, envelope, planned documents and signature slot; does not prove send.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

ValidationRun.doc: Server-generated structural/heuristic checks only. Never implies G1-G6 were reviewed substantively.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

CandidateAssessment.doc: Attributable source-bound G1-G6 review capture, not an automatic decision and never G7. Source inclusion alone cannot verify legal facts. POST is an operator report of an actual assessment, not a request for fabricated PASS.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

AssessmentSource.doc: Backend checks the case and scope of both endpoints.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

AuditEvent.doc: Append-only application audit, not tamper-proof evidence. Passwords, session tokens and raw confidential bodies excluded.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Internal UUID, not a canonical business code.

IdempotencyRecord.doc: Same actor + operation + key + payload replays same response; failed tx leaves no committed result. Expiry is bounded replay horizon, not permanent deduplication.
